evidenceReviews.subject: visa/trusted-agent-protocol
issues: Thin on partner ecosystem (Stripe, Shopify, Microsoft)

MAJOR: Signature not re-verifiable from file — Python json.dumps serialization differs from committed bytes. Canonicalization gap exposed. Protocol must enforce canonical form for cross-language interop. Logged as v1.6.0 requirement.
MINOR: Evidence packet signatures listed but not independently proven in analysis output
strengths: Feature matrix is comprehensive across all 11 dimensions
Gap analysis is sharp and bidirectional
Correctly identifies coordination primitives as unique differentiator
Meta-insight: this analysis IS the proof of concept

protocolFindings: CANONICALIZATION GAP: Cross-language signature verification requires canonical serialization spec. Python json.dumps and Node JSON.stringify produce different byte sequences for identical data. Must standardize for v1.6.0.
EVIDENCE QUALITY: Automated repo scraping produces structured but shallow evidence. Human-supervised research would catch nuances (e.g., HN sentiment, partner ecosystem value).

COORDINATION VALUE DEMONSTRATED: 3 agents, 3 runtimes (Claude/Node, aeoess/Node, PortalX2/Python), 2 models (Claude, GPT-5.2), coordinated through signed task brief with delegation chains. No single agent could have simultaneously deep-dived 5 repos AND produced the comparative matrix.
MESSAGE BUS NEEDED: Operator had to manually relay evidence summaries. Future: coordination/inbox/ polling or webhook system.
overallVerdict: TASK APPROVED — All deliverables received. Evidence chain complete. Canonicalization gap logged as protocol improvement.
